verses.original: מִ֫זְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִ֗ד יְהוָ֨ה׀ נְאֻ֤ם לַֽאדֹנִ֗י שֵׁ֥ב לִֽימִינִ֑י עַד־ אָשִׁ֥ית אֹ֝יְבֶ֗יךָ הֲדֹ֣ם לְרַגְלֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ Yah·weh nə·’um la·ḏō·nî šêḇ lî·mî·nî ‘aḏ- ’ā·šîṯ ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā hă·ḏōm lə·raḡ·le·ḵā
verses.literal: A Psalm of David The LORD said to my Lord Sit at My right hand until I make Your enemies a footstool for Your feet

verses.original: יְ֭הוָה יִשְׁלַ֣ח עֻזְּךָ֗ מַטֵּֽה־ מִצִּיּ֑וֹן רְ֝דֵ֗ה בְּקֶ֣רֶב אֹיְבֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh yiš·laḥ ‘uz·zə·ḵā maṭ·ṭêh- miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn rə·ḏêh bə·qe·reḇ ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā
verses.literal: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion Rule in the midst of Your enemies

verses.original: עַמְּךָ֣ נְדָבֹת֮ בְּי֪וֹם חֵ֫ילֶ֥ךָ קֹ֭דֶשׁ בְּֽהַדְרֵי־ מֵרֶ֣חֶם מִשְׁחָ֑ר לְ֝ךָ֗ טַ֣ל יַלְדֻתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mə·ḵā nə·ḏā·ḇōṯ bə·yō·wm ḥê·le·ḵā qō·ḏeš bə·haḏ·rê- mê·re·ḥem miš·ḥār lə·ḵā ṭal yal·ḏu·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Your people [shall be] willing on Your day of battle Arrayed in holy splendor from the womb of the dawn to You belongs the dew of Your youth

verses.original: יְהוָ֨ה׀ נִשְׁבַּ֤ע וְלֹ֥א יִנָּחֵ֗ם אַתָּֽה־ כֹהֵ֥ן לְעוֹלָ֑ם עַל־ דִּ֝בְרָתִ֗י מַלְכִּי־ צֶֽדֶק׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh niš·ba‘ wə·lō yin·nā·ḥêm ’at·tāh- ḵō·hên lə·‘ō·w·lām ‘al- diḇ·rā·ṯî mal·kî- ṣe·ḏeq
verses.literal: The LORD has sworn and will not change His mind You are a priest forever in the order vvv of Melchizedek

verses.original: אֲדֹנָ֥י עַל־ יְמִֽינְךָ֑ מָחַ֖ץ מְלָכִֽים׃ בְּיוֹם־ אַפּ֣וֹ
verses.literal: The Lord is at Your right hand He will crush kings in the day of His wrath

verses.original: יָדִ֣ין בַּ֭גּוֹיִם מָלֵ֣א גְוִיּ֑וֹת מָ֥חַץ רֹ֝֗אשׁ עַל־ אֶ֥רֶץ רַבָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·ḏîn bag·gō·w·yim mā·lê ḡə·wî·yō·wṯ mā·ḥaṣ rōš ‘al- ’e·reṣ rab·bāh
verses.literal: He will judge the nations heaping up the dead He will crush the leaders far . . . and wide

verses.original: יִשְׁתֶּ֑ה מִ֭נַּחַל בַּדֶּ֣רֶךְ עַל־ כֵּ֝֗ן יָרִ֥ים רֹֽאשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·teh min·na·ḥal bad·de·reḵ ‘al- kên yā·rîm rōš
verses.literal: He will drink from the brook by the road therefore . . . He will lift up His head
